indication: breathing difficulties due to COPD, long-term management of COPD symptoms
single_dose: 60 doses, 400 mcg of aclidinium bromide and 12 mcg of formoterol fumarate dihydrate per dose
mechanism_of_action: opens the airways in adults with COPD by providing long-term bronchodilation through a combination of a long-acting beta2 agonist (LABA) and an anticholinergic agent.
side_effects: headache, dizziness, blurred vision, eye pain or discomfort, temporary blurring of vision, visual halos or colored images in association with red eyes, signs of hypersensitivity reaction, tightness of the chest, coughing, wheezing or breathlessness immediately after inhalation (signs of bronchospasm), difficulties in breathing or swallowing, swelling of tongue, lips and face
unsuitable_population: heart problems such as rapid or irregular heart beat or an abnormal electrical signal called 'prolongation of the QT interval', tumour in one of your adrenal glands (phaeochromocytoma), breastfeeding, patients with asthma
